node.statement: For every finite tensor representation C=sum_l A_l tensor B_l, triangle inequality and submultiplicativity give ||pi(C)||=||sum_l A_lB_l||<=sum_l||A_l||||B_l||; taking the infimum in GT-kitaev-projective-tensor-norm gives ||pi(C)||<=||C||_pi. Thus pi(D)=I_B and ||I_B||=1 imply ||D||_pi>=1, which with the upper bound proves equality without dependence on m or d_r.
